title: Sand People overrun Fort Tusken
summary: Sand People raid and loot Fort Tusken, an outpost beside Tatooine's Jundland Wastes, until its surviving settlers give it up. The fort's chroniclers later make the raiders' siege ballistas famous and give them the name Tusken Raiders.
sources: Star Wars: The Mandalorian Visual Guide

title: Young Dooku meets his lost family
summary: During a Jedi visit to a Serenno festival, the youngling Dooku saves two children from kidnappers and learns they are his siblings, Jenza and Ramil. A groundquake buries him in rubble, and his father, Count Gora, rages that he never wants him back.

title: Yoda takes Dooku as his Padawan
summary: After the Hawk-Bat Clan's Initiate Trials, Grand Master Yoda picks Dooku as his apprentice, and Lene Kostana takes Dooku's close friend Sifo-Dyas. One pupil will one day lead the Separatists; the other will commission the clone army.

title: Solar storm devastates Protobranch
summary: Sifo-Dyas foresees a deadly solar storm on Protobranch. The Council refuses to act on a vision, so he, Dooku and Master Kostana warn the world's senator anyway, and Yoda reluctantly follows them there; the storm still kills much of the population.

title: Sheev Palpatine is born on Naboo
summary: Naboo sees the birth of Sheev Palpatine in the closing years of the High Republic era. Secretly schooled by the Sith Lord Darth Plagueis, he will become Darth Sidious and, in the end, the galaxy's Emperor.

title: Dooku first wields Force lightning
summary: Hunting rumored Sith relics with Lene Kostana and Sifo-Dyas, the Padawan Dooku is seized on Asusto by a dark side coven, the Presagers of Hakotei. Their ritual fills him with visions of what is to come, and he escapes by killing them with Force lightning.

title: Qui-Gon Jinn is born on Coruscant
note: Derived from his age of forty in Master & Apprentice, which is set in 40 BBY.
summary: Qui-Gon Jinn comes into the world on Coruscant. Trained by Dooku, he grows into a maverick Jedi Master devoted to the Living Force, whose discovery of a slave boy on Tatooine will set the Chosen One's story in motion.

title: Mace Windu is born on Haruun Kal
summary: Mace Windu comes into the world on Haruun Kal. He will become Master of the Order, a peerless duelist and one of the very few Jedi to face Darth Sidious blade to blade.
sources: Mace Windu and Other Users of the Force

title: Dooku takes Qui-Gon as his Padawan
summary: When the Heliost Clan completes its Initiate Trials, Dooku, now a Jedi Master, picks the young Qui-Gon Jinn to be his Padawan. The same year master and student see combat together on Shurrupak.

title: Theed power generator opens
summary: A venture between Naboo and Damask Holdings builds a plasma-refining generator in Theed, its stark industrial look a break with Naboo style. Surplus plasma is sold off-world, much of it to the Trade Federation. Decades later, Qui-Gon Jinn dies fighting inside it.
conflict: Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016) has Senator Palpatine attend the opening, which Nexus of Power dates to 65 BBY, but Star Wars: Timelines dates his election as senator to 52 BBY.

title: Wilhuff Tarkin is born on Eriadu
summary: Wilhuff Tarkin is born into Eriadu's powerful Tarkin family. Drawn into politics by Palpatine, he will serve the Republic as an officer, then the Empire as a Grand Moff and the Death Star's commander.

title: The future Millennium Falcon is built
summary: A YT-1300 freighter from Corellia enters service around this time. After many owners and many names it will become the Millennium Falcon, flown by Lando Calrissian and then Han Solo.

title: Dooku offered a seat on the Council
note: Star Wars: Timelines dates Dooku's Council seat to around 58 BBY; the rally attack comes shortly before it.
summary: Probing the sabotage that nearly kills his brother Ramil at Coruscant's Dragonfire Air Rally, Dooku and Qui-Gon find that a crime lord is blackmailing Councilor Yula Braylon. Dooku is then offered a place on the High Council, while Qui-Gon is made a Knight.
wp: Attack at the Dragonfire Air Rally

title: Obi-Wan Kenobi is born on Stewjon
summary: Born on Stewjon, Obi-Wan Kenobi reaches the Jedi Temple before he is half a year old. He will train under Qui-Gon Jinn, teach Anakin Skywalker, and decades later guide Anakin's son Luke.

title: Maul is born on Dathomir
summary: On Dathomir, the Nightsister leader Mother Talzin bears a Zabrak son, Maul. Taken as a boy by Darth Sidious, he will be shaped into a Sith assassin consumed by hatred for the Jedi.

title: Palpatine elected Senator of Naboo
summary: Sheev Palpatine wins the seat representing Naboo in the Galactic Senate. Already secretly Darth Sidious, apprentice to Darth Plagueis, he gives the Sith a foothold for taking the Republic apart from within.

title: Councilor Katri slain on Raxus Secundus
summary: Sent to bring home Councilor Katri's body, Dooku and Mace Windu learn that local guards killed her while trying to coerce their corrupt senator, who dies in the fallout. Windu inherits Katri's Council seat; Dooku comes away half-sympathetic to the killers' complaint against the Senate.

title: Rael Averross forced to kill his Padawan
summary: Mutineers rise aboard the relief freighter Advent. Rael Averross fights them in the cargo hold rather than retake the bridge, and a slicer dart turns his Padawan Nim Pianna on him, so he must kill her. The Council clears him and posts him to Pijal.

title: Padmé Naberrie is born on Naboo
summary: Ruwee and Jobal Naberrie welcome a daughter, Padmé, on Naboo. She will be elected queen at fourteen, serve as a senator through the Clone Wars, and secretly marry Anakin Skywalker.

title: Qui-Gon takes Obi-Wan as his Padawan
summary: Qui-Gon Jinn chooses the young Obi-Wan Kenobi to be his Padawan. The pairing of an unorthodox master with a rule-minded student is often uneasy, but it holds for twelve years, until Qui-Gon's death on Naboo.

title: Ky Narec takes in Asajj Ventress
summary: Marooned on Rattatak, a world ruled by warlords, Ky Narec of the Jedi finds the girl Asajj Ventress after raiders kill the man who owned her. Sensing her power, he trains her as his Padawan while the two defend the locals.

title: Dooku becomes Count and quits the Jedi
summary: Dooku's brother Ramil hires Abyssin mercenaries to sour Serenno on the Republic. Dooku returns home, kills Ramil and claims the title and fortune of Count, then resigns from the Order at sixty. Earlier that year he had been introduced to Senator Palpatine.

title: Anakin Skywalker is born
summary: The enslaved Shmi Skywalker gives birth to a son who has no father. Anakin is a Force vergence, and the Jedi will come to believe him the prophesied Chosen One who will restore the Force's balance.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace
conflict: The Star Wars Book gives Tatooine as his birthplace, while Darth Vader: Sith Lord says records disagree and that he may have reached Tatooine with his mother as a small child.

title: Grogu is born
note: Derived from his stated age of fifty in The Mandalorian, which Star Wars: Timelines places in 9 ABY.
summary: Grogu, of the same rare species as Yoda, is born and raised as an initiate in the Jedi Temple. Carried to safety when the Temple falls, he will resurface decades later as the ward of the Mandalorian Din Djarin.

title: Mandalore's Great Clan Wars
note: Placed after Padawan (41 BBY per Star Wars: Timelines), in which Obi-Wan has not yet met Satine, and before the mission to Pijal (40 BBY), which followed the war.
summary: Pacifist New Mandalorians fight the martial traditionalists in a civil war that wrecks the old capital, Keldabe. Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan spend a year guarding Satine Kryze, who falls for Obi-Wan; her side wins, and the exiled traditionalists become Death Watch.

title: Sidious takes Maul as his apprentice
summary: Darth Sidious visits Mother Talzin on Dathomir and, instead of the apprenticeship she hoped for, leaves with her young son Maul. Talzin never forgives the theft, and Maul trains for years as the Sith's hidden weapon against the Jedi.
conflict: In Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir, Talzin says Sidious stole Maul from her; the in-universe legend An Unwilling Apprentice has Talzin surrender him at Sidious's demand before Sidious chooses him at a Selection contest.

title: Sidious murders Darth Plagueis
note: No source names the year. The StarWars.com Databank places the murder after Sidious took Maul as apprentice (c. 40 BBY per Star Wars: Timelines) and before the Invasion of Naboo (32 BBY).
summary: Having learned all he needs, Darth Sidious kills his master, Plagueis the Wise, as he sleeps, just as the Rule of Two demands. He inherits Plagueis's research into cheating death, the lure he will later dangle before Anakin Skywalker.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith
Star Wars: The Secrets of the Sith

title: Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan's mission to Pijal
summary: Qui-Gon and young Obi-Wan travel to Pijal to oversee a treaty between its monarchy and Czerka, working with the regent Rael Averross. They find Princess Fanry herself behind the Blackguard terrorists, and her coronation is stopped. Qui-Gon also declines a High Council seat.

title: Sifo-Dyas joins the Jedi High Council
summary: Sifo-Dyas joins the Council that leads the Jedi Order. His recurring visions of a coming war increasingly set him against his fellow councilors, and he will eventually act on them without their consent.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

title: Gardulla loses Anakin and Shmi to Watto
summary: The Hutt crime lord Gardulla bets on the podraces and loses two of her slaves to Watto, a Toydarian who runs a junk shop in Mos Espa: Shmi Skywalker and her small son Anakin.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace
Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know

title: Ahsoka Tano is born on Shili
summary: In a Togruta village on Shili, a girl named Ahsoka Tano is born. Found by Plo Koon a few years later, she will become Anakin Skywalker's Padawan and, after leaving the Order, a key figure of the rebellion era.

title: Thrawn's trap in the Kinoss system
summary: To prove the Lioaoin Regime backs piracy, the young Chiss officer Thrawn poses as a merchant and draws pirate corsairs through hyperspace into the Kinoss system, where Ar'alani's patrol cruiser Parala destroys them. It opens the Chiss campaign against the Lioaoin pirates.

title: Battle of the Malastare Narrows
summary: Admiral Trench of the Corporate Alliance blockades Malastare and mauls the Republic fleet sent against him, with Wullf Yularen among its officers. A Jedi task force under Kep-She wrecks Trench's flagship; he is thought dead but survives.

title: Sidious brings Maul to Malachor
summary: Sidious takes his apprentice to Malachor, where the ash of Sith warriors killed in an ancient battle gives Maul visions of their deaths at Jedi hands. The experience deepens his loathing for the Jedi Order.

title: Ky Narec killed; Dooku claims Ventress
note: Star Wars: Timelines puts her apprenticeship to Narec in 44 BBY and Dark Disciple says they served Rattatak for ten years, placing his death around 34 BBY; Dooku finds her some time after.
summary: Pirates kill Ky Narec, and the grieving Ventress makes herself warlord of Rattatak until a rival, Osika Kirske, captures her and forces her into his arena. Count Dooku frees her and makes her his dark side pupil and assassin.

title: Sifo-Dyas secretly orders a clone army
summary: Convinced by his visions that war is coming, Jedi Master Sifo-Dyas secretly commissions the cloners of Kamino to grow the Republic an army, without the Jedi Council's approval. The Sith soon take quiet control of the project.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones
conflict: Star Wars: Timelines and Star Wars Insider 206 place the order in 33 BBY, while in Attack of the Clones the Kaminoans date it to almost ten years before 22 BBY, nearer 32 BBY.

title: Massacre at the Eriadu Conference
summary: At a trade summit held on Eriadu, the radical Nebula Front kills much of the Trade Federation's leadership and several Kuat Drive Yards executives, while Chancellor Valorum survives an attempt on his life. Nute Gunray rises to Viceroy, as Darth Sidious intended.

title: Maul hunts a captive Padawan
summary: Sent to silence witnesses to the Trade Federation's plans, Maul hears that the Xrexus Cartel is auctioning a captured Padawan, Eldra Kaitis. With Cad Bane and Aurra Sing he takes her, then duels and kills her, hungry for a real fight with the Jedi.

title: Padmé crowned Queen Amidala
summary: At fourteen, Padmé Naberrie unseats the isolationist Queen Sanandrassa and is crowned under the regnal name Amidala. With Captain Panaka she recruits handmaidens who serve as her decoys and guards.

title: Senate taxes the Free Trade Zones
summary: At Chancellor Valorum's urging, the Senate passes Prop 31-814D, taxing trade in the outlying Free Trade Zones. The Trade Federation's fury over the levy hands Darth Sidious the pretext he needs.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace
Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy

title: Trade Federation blockades and invades Naboo
summary: Secretly steered by Darth Sidious, the Federation throws a blockade around Naboo over the tax, tries to kill the Jedi envoys sent to negotiate, and lands a droid army that takes Theed. Queen Amidala will not sign a treaty making the occupation legal.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

title: Anakin wins the Boonta Eve Classic
summary: Stranded on Tatooine with the Queen, Qui-Gon Jinn meets the slave boy Anakin Skywalker and senses his enormous Force potential. Anakin wins the Boonta Eve podrace, earning parts for the Queen's ship and his own freedom, and leaves his mother to become a Jedi.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

title: The Sith reveal themselves on Tatooine
summary: Tracking the Queen's ship, Darth Maul ambushes Qui-Gon Jinn in the desert outside Mos Espa. Qui-Gon escapes aboard the departing starship and reports the first Sith warrior seen by the Jedi in about a thousand years.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

title: Amidala topples Chancellor Valorum
summary: With her appeal lost in Senate procedure, Queen Amidala takes Senator Palpatine's advice and moves to oust Chancellor Valorum through a no-confidence vote. Valorum falls, and Amidala leaves Coruscant resolved to free Naboo herself.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

title: Dooku erases Kamino from the Archives
summary: Visiting the Jedi Temple as Qui-Gon reports his clash with a Sith, Dooku slips into the Archives and uses Sifo-Dyas's clearance to scrub Kamino's star system from the records, keeping the Jedi ignorant of the clone army.

title: Palpatine elected Supreme Chancellor
note: Elected while Amidala returns to Naboo; he arrives there as Chancellor after the battle.
summary: Buoyed by sympathy for his occupied homeworld, Senator Palpatine of Naboo wins the Senate's backing to replace Valorum at the head of the Republic. No one suspects that its new leader is the Sith Lord who engineered the crisis that raised him.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

title: Battle of Naboo
summary: Now allied with the Gungans, Amidala strikes back: the Gungan army draws the droids onto the grasslands, the Queen captures Viceroy Gunray in the palace, and young Anakin destroys the droid control ship, shutting down the invasion army.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

title: Maul kills Qui-Gon Jinn
summary: Deep in Theed's power generator, Darth Maul runs Qui-Gon Jinn through. Obi-Wan Kenobi avenges him, cutting Maul in two and sending him down a reactor shaft. Presumed dead, Maul survives and later hides on the junk world Lotho Minor.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

title: Obi-Wan knighted and takes Anakin as Padawan
summary: The Council raises Obi-Wan Kenobi to Knight and, honoring Qui-Gon's last wish, lets him train Anakin Skywalker despite Yoda's doubts. Qui-Gon is cremated on Naboo, and a parade in Theed celebrates the new peace between Naboo's humans and Gungans.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

title: Dooku kills Yaddle and becomes Tyranus
summary: Shaken by Qui-Gon's death, Dooku meets Darth Sidious in secret. Master Yaddle follows him and confronts them both; at Sidious's urging Dooku kills her, completing his fall. He is reborn as Darth Tyranus, Sidious's new apprentice.

title: Sifo-Dyas murdered on Tyranus's orders
summary: Pushed off the Council for warning of war, Sifo-Dyas has gone in secret to Oba Diah with Silman, Valorum's personal aide, to bargain with the Pykes. On Tyranus's orders the Pykes shoot down his shuttle, and Silman is held as a hostage.

title: Tyranus recruits Jango Fett as clone template
summary: As Tyranus, Dooku recruits the renowned bounty hunter Jango Fett, whose DNA will be copied for the entire Kaminoan army. Under Sith direction, every clone is also fitted with a behavioral chip that will compel obedience to Order 66.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

title: Boba Fett is born on Kamino
summary: As part of his fee, Jango Fett takes an unaltered clone to raise as his son, Boba. A near-identical female clone, later called Omega, stays on Kamino as assistant to the scientist Nala Se.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

title: Secret orders for a clone war fleet
summary: An unnamed buyer places vast orders for weapons and warships with Kuat Drive Yards, whose subsidiary Rothana Heavy Engineering quietly designs Acclamator-class assault ships to carry the clone army growing on Kamino.

title: Sidious begins his Jakku observatory
summary: Darth Sidious starts building a secret observatory on the desert world Jakku. By 25 BBY his adviser Yupe Tashu has droids digging into the Plaintive Hand plateau, guarded by the orphan Gallius Rax, newly taken into Sidious's service.

title: Obi-Wan and Anakin on Carnelion IV
summary: Answering a distress call, Obi-Wan and his twelve-year-old Padawan find Carnelion IV torn apart by the Open–Closed War, and a Republic fleet arrives to enforce a ceasefire. Meanwhile Chancellor Palpatine cultivates Anakin, even touring Coruscant's lower levels with him incognito.

title: Padmé Amidala becomes Senator of Naboo
summary: After two terms, Padmé Amidala leaves the throne. Her successor, Queen Réillata, asks her to represent Naboo in the Galactic Senate, where she soon campaigns for relief to the quake-stricken world Bromlarch alongside Senator Rush Clovis.

title: Cliegg Lars frees and marries Shmi
summary: Tatooine farmer Cliegg Lars purchases Shmi Skywalker's freedom from Watto and marries her, taking her to his homestead. Anakin, far away in Jedi training, does not learn of it until years later.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

title: Thrawn breaks the Vagaari; Thrass dies
summary: Senior Captain Thrawn leads the Chiss to a crushing win over the Vagaari pirates, but a ship from outside Chiss space, caught up in the fighting, crashes and kills his adoptive brother, Syndic Thrass. The Ascendancy's rulers blame Thrawn and take his cruiser Springhawk.

title: Tyranus arms the coming war on Sullust
summary: On Sidious's orders, Tyranus reaches a deal on Sullust with the Kaldana Syndicate of arms dealers while, as Count Dooku, he signs a trade pact between Serenno and SoroSuub. When the Jedi Jak'zin comes to investigate, Dooku kills him.

title: Galen and Lyra Erso marry
summary: The scientist Galen Erso marries Lyra, whom he met on Espinar, in a ceremony on Coruscant. Galen's work on crystal-based energy will draw the attention of his old friend Orson Krennic and, through him, the Republic's hidden weapons program.
wp: Wedding of Lyra and Galen Erso
sources: Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide

title: Dooku's Raxus Address launches the Separatists
summary: Count Dooku denounces a corrupt Republic in the Raxus Address and founds the Separatist Confederacy. Thousands of star systems secede and form their own Separatist Senate, opening the Separatist Crisis that will end in open war.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones
conflict: Wookieepedia's timeline dates the Confederacy's founding both to this address in 24 BBY (Rise of the Separatists, Star Wars: Timelines) and to the Geonosian accord of 22 BBY, when its corporate backers formally join (Attack of the Clones).

title: Emergency Powers Act keeps Palpatine in office
summary: As systems secede, the Senate amends the constitution so Chancellor Palpatine can stay in office past his term limits while the crisis lasts. Palpatine gathers trusted senators, Padmé Amidala among them, into a Loyalist Committee.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

title: The Andors take Kassa from Kenari
summary: Children of Kenari's Alpha tribe explore a crashed transport bearing the new Separatist emblem, and a surviving officer kills their leader. The boy Kassa stays behind in the wreck, where the salvagers Maarva and Clem Andor find him and take him off-world as Cassian.
wp: Exploratory mission to investigate a downed craft

title: Amidala fights the Military Creation Act
summary: The Military Creation Act, a bill to raise an army against the Separatists, has been debated since the secessions began. Although she sits on Palpatine's Loyalist Committee, Senator Amidala leads the resistance to it, and her stand makes her a target.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

title: Assassins target Senator Amidala
summary: Separatist leaders hire Jango Fett to silence Senator Amidala before the army vote. A bomb on her landing platform kills her decoy and poisonous kouhuns fail to finish the job; when his agent Zam Wesell is caught, Jango kills her before she can talk.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

title: Obi-Wan discovers the clone army
summary: Following a poisoned dart to Kamino, a planet absent from the Jedi records, Obi-Wan Kenobi finds a vast clone army supposedly commissioned by the dead Sifo-Dyas and grown from Jango Fett. He trails Jango to Geonosis, where the Separatists are massing droids.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

title: Shmi dies; Anakin slaughters the Tuskens
summary: Haunted by nightmares, Anakin returns to Tatooine and finds his mother, seized weeks earlier by Tusken Raiders, dying in their camp. When she dies he massacres the whole camp, then confesses his rage to Padmé.
wp: Mission to rescue Shmi Skywalker Lars
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

title: Senate grants war powers; clone army activated
summary: With Separatist droid armies revealed on Geonosis, Representative Jar Jar Binks moves to give Chancellor Palpatine emergency powers. The Senate agrees, and Palpatine's first act is to commission the Kaminoan clones as the Republic's Grand Army.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

title: The Clone Wars
summary: For three years, clone troopers led by Jedi generals battle the Separatist droid armies across the galaxy. Darth Sidious secretly steers both sides, and when the fighting stops the Jedi Order lies in ruins and the Republic has become his Empire.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones
Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

title: First Battle of Geonosis opens the war
summary: Some two hundred Jedi storm the Geonosis arena to save Obi-Wan, Anakin and Padmé, and most die before Yoda arrives with the clones. Jango Fett falls to Mace Windu, and Dooku maims Anakin before escaping with plans for a battle station.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

title: Anakin and Padmé marry in secret
summary: Defying the Jedi rule against attachment, Anakin and Padmé wed in secret at the lake retreat of Varykino on Naboo, with only C-3PO and the astromech R2-D2 as witnesses.
wp: Wedding of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

title: Bombing of Zarra on Cato Neimoidia
summary: A blast tears a district of the bridge city Zarra from its moorings, killing thousands on Cato Neimoidia. Obi-Wan and a Neimoidian guard, Ruug Quarnom, find a third party behind it, and the newly knighted Anakin defies orders to save his master from Ventress's frame-up.

title: Battle of Christophsis
summary: General Loathsom's droids besiege the crystal world Christophsis behind Admiral Trench's blockade. Anakin breaks the blockade in a stealth ship, Rex and Cody unmask the traitor clone Slick, and after a long siege the Republic drives the droid army off.

title: Ahsoka Tano becomes Anakin's Padawan
summary: Yoda assigns the fourteen-year-old Togruta Ahsoka Tano to Anakin Skywalker, who never asked for a Padawan. She arrives mid-battle on Christophsis and helps him wreck the droids' shield generator, beginning the partnership that anchors the Clone Wars.

title: Rescue of Jabba's son wins the Hutts
summary: Dooku has Ventress kidnap Jabba the Hutt's infant son Rotta to turn the Hutts against the Republic. Anakin and Ahsoka storm the monastery on Teth and return Rotta, winning the Republic use of Hutt space, while Padmé exposes Ziro the Hutt's part.

title: Battle of Ryloth
summary: Separatist forces occupy the Twi'lek homeworld. Bail Organa and Jar Jar Binks win Toydaria's help with relief, and in 21 BBY the Republic breaks the blockade, frees the hostage city of Nabat and, with Cham Syndulla's resistance, liberates Ryloth.

title: Yoda's stand on Rugosa
summary: To win over King Katuunko of Toydaria, Yoda accepts Ventress's challenge on the coral moon Rugosa. With just three clone troopers he defeats her droid army, and Katuunko pledges his world's support to the Republic.

title: Onderon's civil war
note: The end is dated to 20 BBY; the start follows from the war lasting two years.
summary: Onderon's Separatist-backed court faces a rebel insurgency. In 20 BBY rebels trained by Jedi and by Captain Rex overthrow King Sanjay Rash and restore King Dendup, but their leader Steela Gerrera dies, leaving her brother Saw to fight on.

title: Hunt for the Malevolence
summary: Grievous's giant warship Malevolence cripples Republic fleets with its ion cannon, destroying Plo Koon's fleet at Abregado and a medical convoy. Its strike on the Kaliida Nebula medical station fails, and Anakin's forces later destroy it.

title: Rookies hold Rishi Station
summary: Commando droids overrun a listening post on the Rishi Moon. A few surviving rookies, among them Echo and Fives, fight back with Rex and Cody and blow up the outpost, cutting the false all-clear that masked a fleet bound for Kamino.

title: R2-D2 lost at Bothawui and rescued
summary: Grievous uses the Skytop Station listening post to strike Republic targets. At Bothawui Anakin outfights him but loses R2-D2, whose memory holds Republic secrets; he and Ahsoka trace the droid to Skytop, rescue him and destroy the station.

title: Pirates capture Count Dooku
summary: After a failed Jedi attempt to seize him near Vanqor, Count Dooku is captured by Hondo Ohnaka's pirates, who soon hold Obi-Wan and Anakin too and demand a ransom from the Republic. Jar Jar and a clone escort free the Jedi, but Dooku escapes.

title: Blue Shadow Virus plot on Naboo
summary: The Separatist scientist Nuvo Vindi revives the extinct Blue Shadow Virus in a lab hidden beneath Naboo, meaning to loose it on the galaxy. Padmé and Jar Jar expose him, and after Padmé and Ahsoka are infected, Obi-Wan and Anakin bring a cure from Iego.

title: Cad Bane steals the Jedi's list of children
summary: Working for Darth Sidious, Cad Bane steals a holocron out of the Jedi Temple's vault and tortures Master Bolla Ropal for a kyber crystal listing Force-sensitive infants. Bane abducts several children before Anakin and Ahsoka free them from a facility on Mustafar.

title: Zillo Beast rampages across Coruscant
summary: An experimental bomb that halts a droid army on Malastare also wakes a Zillo Beast, thought extinct. Palpatine has it shipped to Coruscant to study its near-invulnerable hide; it breaks loose, tears through the city and is finally killed with poison gas.

title: Second Battle of Geonosis
summary: Learning that Poggle the Lesser has restarted the droid foundries of Geonosis, the Republic invades again. Its forces destroy the main factory, kill Karina the Great, queen of the hives, beneath the Progate Temple, and take Poggle prisoner.

title: Work begins on a secret battle station
summary: Palpatine hands the Geonosian battle-station plans that Dooku brought him to a secret Republic body, the Strategic Advisory Cell. Fearing the Separatists are building such a weapon, it funds the project in secret, and by year's end construction is under way above Geonosis.
sources: Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide

title: Jyn Erso is born on Vallt
summary: Galen and Lyra Erso's daughter Jyn is born on Vallt, where Separatist sympathizers soon detain the family. Orson Krennic arranges their rescue and brings them to Coruscant, drawing Galen into his secret weapons research.

title: Death Watch's plot against Mandalore exposed
summary: Sent to learn whether neutral Mandalore has joined the Separatists, Obi-Wan finds Duchess Satine under attack by Death Watch bombers. On Concordia its leader proves to be the moon's governor, Pre Vizsla, backed by Dooku; Satine then defends her world's neutrality before the Senate.

title: Boba Fett's revenge on Mace Windu
summary: Posing as a clone cadet, Boba Fett sabotages the Star Destroyer Endurance to kill Mace Windu, his father's killer. Windu survives the crash on Vanqor, and Plo Koon and Ahsoka later free Boba's hostages and arrest him on Florrum.

title: Battle of Kamino
summary: Grievous and Ventress assault Tipoca City to destroy the clone factories at their source. Clone troopers under Rex and Cody, with Echo and Fives among them, fight alongside Obi-Wan and Anakin to repel the raid, which shows that no Republic world is safe.

title: Cad Bane takes the Senate hostage
summary: Hired by the Hutts, bounty hunters under Cad Bane seize the Senate Building and hold senators and Chancellor Palpatine until the Republic frees Ziro the Hutt. Bane escapes with Ziro, who is later killed on Teth by the singer Sy Snootles on Jabba's orders.

title: Peace initiative wrecked by a bombing
summary: Padmé and Mina Bonteri, a Separatist senator and her old mentor, steer their senates toward talks, but a bombing of Coruscant's power grid ordered by Dooku turns opinion against peace. Bonteri is later murdered, and Dooku withdraws the Separatist offer.
wp: Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid

title: Dooku casts off Ventress
summary: Ordered by Sidious to prove his loyalty, Dooku has Ventress's ship shot down at Sullust. She survives and returns to the Nightsisters on Dathomir, and Mother Talzin sends her with her sisters to assassinate Dooku, a strike that fails.

title: Savage Opress unleashed
summary: Talzin remakes the Nightbrother Savage Opress with dark magick and plants him with Dooku as a new apprentice. He slaughters Jedi at a temple on Devaron, then turns on Dooku alongside Ventress, and flees when their attack fails.

title: Anakin tested as the Chosen One on Mortis
summary: Lured by an ancient signal, Ahsoka, Anakin and Obi-Wan reach Mortis, home of three godlike Force wielders. The Father confirms Anakin's status as the Chosen One, but by the end all three wielders are dead, and Anakin's glimpse of his dark future is wiped away.

title: Breakout from the Citadel
summary: A Jedi strike team slips into the Citadel, the Separatists' prison fortress on Lola Sayu, to rescue Master Even Piell along with Captain Wilhuff Tarkin, as each knows half of a vital hyperspace route. Piell dies, but Tarkin carries the secret home.

title: Ahsoka hunted on Wasskah
summary: Captured on Felucia, Ahsoka is dropped on the moon Wasskah, where Trandoshans hunt Jedi younglings for sport. She rallies the surviving captives and, joined by the Wookiee Chewbacca and his kin, turns the hunt back on the hunters.

title: Battle of Mon Cala
summary: After their king's death, Separatist-backed Quarren under Riff Tamson rise against the young heir, Prince Lee-Char. Clones, Jedi and a Gungan army join the defense; Tamson is killed and Lee-Char is crowned over a reunited Mon Cala.

title: Battle of Umbara
summary: When Umbara defects, Jedi Master Pong Krell takes over the 501st and spends clone lives recklessly, even tricking two units into firing on each other. Rex's troopers uncover his treachery; Krell, who hoped to become Dooku's apprentice, is shot by a clone.

title: Togruta colonists freed from slavers
summary: Zygerrian slavers allied with Dooku empty Kiros, a Togruta colony. Anakin, Ahsoka and Obi-Wan go undercover on Zygerria, and after Obi-Wan and Rex fall captive, Republic forces storm the Kadavo processing center and free the survivors.

title: Obi-Wan fakes his death to save Palpatine
summary: The Council stages Obi-Wan's apparent murder so he can take the identity of Rako Hardeen, a hired gun, hiding the ruse even from Anakin. Undercover, he joins Moralo Eval's scheme to kidnap Palpatine and helps foil it at Naboo's Festival of Light.

title: Grievous annihilates the Nightsisters
summary: In reprisal for Talzin's plots against Dooku, Grievous leads a droid army to Dathomir. For all Talzin's magick and her undead warriors, the Nightsister clan is nearly wiped out; Ventress survives alone and turns to bounty hunting.

title: Savage finds Maul alive
summary: Guided by Talzin, Savage Opress finds his brother Maul on the junk world Lotho Minor, half-mad and walking on spider-like mechanical legs. Talzin restores his mind and body, and Maul sets out with Savage to take revenge on Obi-Wan Kenobi.

title: Maul and Savage strike on Florrum
summary: Maul and Savage Opress, now roving pirates, besiege Hondo Ohnaka's base on Florrum. Obi-Wan and Adi Gallia come to Hondo's aid; Savage kills Gallia, and the brothers barely escape Obi-Wan.

title: Maul forges the Shadow Collective
summary: Maul unites Death Watch with the Black Sun and Pyke syndicates and forces the Hutts into line, creating a criminal army called the Shadow Collective. Its first prize is Mandalore, still ruled by the pacifist Duchess Satine.

title: Maul seizes Mandalore; Satine killed
summary: Staging crimes that Death Watch then stops, the Shadow Collective topples Satine's government. Maul kills Pre Vizsla to claim the Darksaber and rules through a puppet, then murders Satine before Obi-Wan's eyes; Bo-Katan's loyalists free Obi-Wan.

title: Sidious kills Savage and takes Maul
summary: Seeing his former apprentice as a rival, Darth Sidious comes to Mandalore in person, kills Savage Opress in a duel with both brothers, and carries off the beaten Maul to serve his own ends.

title: Ahsoka framed and leaves the Jedi Order
summary: A bombing at the Temple's hangar kills Jedi and clones, and Ahsoka is framed for it. Expelled and tried by a Republic court, she is cleared when Anakin unmasks Barriss Offee as the bomber, yet she declines to rejoin the Order.
wp: Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar
sources: The Jedi Who Knew Too Much

title: Fives uncovers the clones' inhibitor chips
summary: At Ringo Vinda the clone Tup suddenly kills his Jedi general, Tiplar. Investigating, ARC trooper Fives finds a chip in Tup's brain that drove the act, but Palpatine has him framed as an assassin, and Fives is shot before anyone listens.

title: Thrawn fights alongside Anakin on Mokivj
summary: On Batuu, Anakin meets the Chiss officer Thrawn, who is searching the wider galaxy for help against the Nikardun threat. With Padmé they wreck a Separatist factory building cortosis-armored droids on Mokivj, though the fight ruins much of the planet's farmland.

title: Jedi learn Tyranus's role in the clone army
summary: A lightsaber found on a moon of Oba Diah leads Obi-Wan and Anakin to the Pykes, who admit killing Sifo-Dyas for a Sith Lord named Tyranus. Dooku arrives to silence them, and the Jedi realize the Sith had a hand in creating their army.

title: Yoda's trials on Moraband
summary: Guided by the voice of the late Qui-Gon Jinn, Yoda seeks the secret of keeping one's identity after death. His quest ends on the Sith world Moraband, where he withstands illusions of Darth Bane and an assault by Sidious, and proves ready to learn it.

title: The Outer Rim Sieges
summary: With the Separatists pushed back to the galaxy's outer reaches, the Republic besieges their strongholds in the war's last campaign. Grievous counterattacks hard, and Jedi generals are spread across worlds such as Mygeeto, Saleucami and Felucia.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

title: Battle of Anaxes and Echo's rescue
summary: Admiral Trench strikes at the vital shipyards of Anaxes. The experimental squad Clone Force 99 finds the enemy using a captured clone's mind to predict Republic moves, and helps Anakin and Rex rescue Echo from Skako Minor before Trench falls.

title: Talzin dies in a Sith showdown on Dathomir
summary: Escaping Sidious's prison, Maul captures Dooku and Grievous at Ord Mantell and brings Dooku to Mother Talzin, who needs his life force to regain her body. Sidious and Grievous arrive; in the fight Grievous kills Talzin, and Maul flees.
sources: Star Wars: Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir

title: Ventress and Quinlan Vos hunt Dooku
summary: The Council secretly teams Asajj Ventress with Quinlan Vos, a Jedi Master, to assassinate Dooku. The pair fall in love, but Vos is captured and turned by Dooku; Ventress dies shielding him from the Count's lightning, and her sacrifice redeems him.

title: Siege of Mandalore; Maul captured
summary: At Bo-Katan's request, Ahsoka and Rex lead a detachment of the 501st to free Mandalore from Maul's puppet regime. Ahsoka defeats and captures Maul, who warns her that Anakin is being groomed as Sidious's next apprentice.

title: Battle of Coruscant; Dooku executed
summary: Grievous's fleet strikes the capital and abducts the Chancellor. Aboard the flagship Invisible Hand, Anakin defeats Dooku and, urged on by Palpatine, beheads the disarmed Count, then crash-lands the burning ship with Obi-Wan.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

title: Delegation of 2,000 challenges Palpatine
summary: Alarmed by the Chancellor's swelling authority, senators meet in secret at Bail Organa's Cantham House. Padmé Amidala, Mon Mothma and others help frame a formal petition from two thousand senators urging Palpatine to surrender his emergency powers, an early seed of the Rebellion.

title: Obi-Wan kills Grievous on Utapau
summary: Tipped off that Grievous is hiding on Utapau, the Republic sends Obi-Wan with the 7th Sky Corps. Obi-Wan duels the cyborg general, chases him through the sinkhole city and kills him with a blaster, and the Separatist command collapses.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

title: Mace Windu confronts Darth Sidious
summary: Told by Anakin that Palpatine is secretly Sidious, Windu and three fellow Masters try to arrest him; Sidious cuts the others down at once. Windu disarms him, but as he moves to strike, Anakin severs his hand and Sidious hurls him to his death.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

title: Anakin Skywalker becomes Darth Vader
summary: Convinced that only Sidious's dark arts can keep Padmé from the death he has foreseen, Anakin Skywalker pledges himself to the Sith Lord and is named Darth Vader. His first task is to lead clones against the Jedi Temple.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

title: Order 66: the clones turn on the Jedi
summary: Branding the Jedi traitors, Palpatine issues Order 66, and the clones' chips drive them to kill their generals across the galaxy. Ki-Adi-Mundi, Aayla Secura, Plo Koon and many more die; Yoda, Obi-Wan, Ahsoka and a scattered few escape.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

title: Ahsoka and Rex survive Order 66
summary: Aboard the Star Destroyer Tribunal, Rex warns Ahsoka to find Fives before his chip takes over. She frees Maul as a diversion, removes Rex's chip, and the two escape as the ship crashes onto a moon, then bury the clones who died there.

title: Vader leads the assault on the Jedi Temple
summary: Darth Vader and the 501st Legion storm the Jedi Temple, killing Jedi and younglings alike. A few slip away, Kelleran Beq carrying the young Grogu among them, while Bail Organa, turned back at the gates, sees clones gun down a fleeing Padawan.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith
